exact_response:
People shouldn’t owe an apology simply because they share a race with someone who did wrong. That principle applies to Black people and every other racial group.

Responsibility rests with people for their own actions. Institutions may also owe acknowledgment or repair for harms they caused or perpetuated, but that’s different from assigning guilt by race.
